Game Overview

In Angry Ninja, the core idea is straightforward: engage in intense, mid-air battles as a vengeful ninja, using swift agility and precision in throwing star combat. Master aerial attacks and dodges against cunning pirates, navigating through vividly detailed environments. With sleek controls and escalating challenges, triumph over foes in relentless, high-speed action.
